name: Streaming Relational Integrity In Multi Agent Ai Systems A Polarity Model Framework For Hu 41D6938Fe0
text: Relational Integrity in Multi-Agent AI Systems argues that AI safety approaches which specify outcomes in advance become brittle when reality moves beyond the specification and can become sterile through over-constraint. This extends Kaal's brittleness mechanism for explicitly programmed legal expert systems to a broader AI-safety architecture setting. The abstract supplies an architectural claim, not a measured failure rate or evidence that every specified safety constraint is harmful.
